_: §36.1: the switcher needs a ws url per chunk id. precedence: ?server= override, then this file, then VITE_SERVER_URL, then the default port. an https page cannot open ws:// so these local entries are ignored in production; deployment replaces them with wss:// urls — under the §44.5 one-service shape, wss://<app>/ws/<chunkId> per chunk, same origin throughout. local dev can use per-port processes (below) or one supervisor (CHUNKS=all PORT=8820 -> ws://127.0.0.1:8820/ws/<chunkId>).
